description: This source file defines a singleton enum 'StatusActivityBuilder' with a static method to build and return an activity status object ('StatusPill.Activity') based on various properties of the application model, voice wake status, and camera HUD state. It encapsulates logic to determine the current status indicator for the app's UI.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Constructs a 'StatusPill.Activity' object representing the current status of the app based on conditions such as background state, gateway status, screen recording, camera HUD state, and voice wake status.
